name: @meridian/traders
description: Autonomous LLM trading bots for Meridian. A fleet of goal-oriented agents, each with its own trader wallet and OpenRouter model, that observe markets through tools (price, history, strikes, book, balance), reason via LangGraph, and place real on-chain wagers. Distinct from the platform itself — all bot logic is new; only @meridian/sdk is reused for the on-chain transaction format.
